headline: Home Depot Beats Third-Quarter Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Home Depot reported third-quarter earnings per share that beat Wall Street consensus estimates by $0.02, while quarterly revenue also topped expectations.
why: Home Depot is the largest home improvement retailer in the United States and a key indicator of consumer spending and housing market activity.

impacts.name: Home Depot
impacts.why: Quarterly earnings per share and top-line sales exceeded Wall Street consensus estimates.
